edits.replace:
- **Landed after that closure, and it is debt rather than a slice.** Authored group values have one reader. `readPluginValues` in `contract/keyframe-shape.ts` already said so and every validation-side consumer asked it, while `ProjectRuntime.#setKeyframe` read the field off the group and the pure editors read it through the reserved constant: one authored layout with three readers, all typed, all agreeing, which is why nothing in the suite could fail on it. The reader gains a typed signature over the same body rather than a second function, so a caller that already proved the shape gets the authored leaf type and the tolerant view stays for an unvalidated document. One place the three did not agree: membership was `Object.hasOwn` on the runtime path and `in` in the editor, so removing `toString` read an inherited name as an authored leaf, rewrote the section and answered with a new record, against the idempotence rule that module states once for every primitive. `RA-106` through `RA-108` are its evidence, the source gate among them for the reason `LF-2` exists, and it earns no ADR: ADR-049 already named the owner and this is the two call sites that did not ask it. [Issue #255](https://github.com/chahyasantoso/motion5/issues/255).
